summary: Sangoma Technologies filed a Form 6-K on June 4, 2026, announcing the retirement of CFO Larry Stock effective June 30, 2026, and the appointment of Adrian Back (current SVP, Finance) as Interim CFO effective July 1, 2026. Stock will remain in a senior advisory role for one year to ensure orderly transition. The Board has commenced a search for a permanent successor, considering internal and external candidates. The filing emphasizes no disagreement with Stock on operations, policies, or practices. This is a planned CFO succession with no forced departure. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1. Watch for announcement of a permanent CFO candidate to gauge continuity.
